class.name: EffectBeam3D
class.brief_description: A camera-facing strip between two points: electric arcs, lasers, tracers, energy beams.
class.description: Draws a strip from this node to [member end_position] that always turns its face to the camera. [member noise_amplitude] makes it wobble like an electric arc, [member texture] is laid along it and can scroll, [member taper] narrows it towards the end. As a child of a [ParticleEffect3D] it is a timed track: it is shown from its start time (see [method ParticleEffect3D.set_emitter_delay]) for its duration and fades out over it, or follows an intensity curve; with no duration it stays on. [method ParticleEffect3D.set_target_position] aims every beam of an effect at a point in the world.

method.name: set_global_end_position
method.description: Sets [member end_position] from a point in world space.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the beam is added to what is behind it (glowing energy). If [code]false[/code], it is alpha blended (smoke trails, ropes of water).
Multiplies the color. Values above [code]1[/code] glow with the environment's glow enabled.
Color of the beam; its alpha is the opacity.
Where the beam ends, relative to this node.
Fades the whole beam between [code]0[/code] (invisible) and [code]1[/code]. Animated by [ParticleEffect3D]; not saved.
How far the beam wobbles sideways, in meters. Both ends stay in place. [code]0[/code] gives a straight beam.
Number of wobble waves per meter of the beam.
How fast the wobble changes. High values flicker like electricity.
Number of pieces the strip is made of. A wobbling beam needs more than a straight one.
Narrows the beam towards its end: [code]0[/code] keeps the width, [code]1[/code] ends in a point.
Texture laid along the beam (U runs from start to end, V across it). Without one the beam is a soft bright line.
How fast [member texture] moves along the beam, in repeats per second.
Repeats of [member texture] per meter of the beam.
Width of the beam in meters.
